description.zh-CN: 体素风格多科室教学医院（V4 诊所的扩展版）：门诊大厅与挂号台、两间门诊诊室、药房；急诊科含预检分诊、两张抢救床位的抢救室、两间急诊诊室、急诊护士站与救护车通道；影像科（X 线、CT、MRI、PET-CT、介入导管室、超声及铅玻璃控制台）、检验科（含血库与微生物）、病理与遗传科、综合病房（4 床）、重症监护室（2 床）、手术室与刷手间、内镜中心、病例讨论室与医生办公室；室外有疗愈花园（池塘、长椅、树木、花卉）、建造园地与工作台、停车场、公交站和道路。患者床位覆盖门诊、急诊、住院/病房、ICU、手术室与社区全部场景。
description.en: A voxel multi-department teaching hospital that grows the V4 clinic into a full campus: main lobby with registration, two outpatient consult rooms and a pharmacy; an Emergency Department with triage, a two-bay resuscitation room, two cubicles, a nurse station and an ambulance bay; radiology (X-ray, CT, MRI, PET-CT, cath lab, ultrasound and a lead-glass control console), a clinical laboratory with blood bank and microbiology, pathology & genetics, a four-bed general ward, a two-bed ICU, an operating theatre with scrub room, an endoscopy suite, a case-conference room and doctors' office; outside, the healing garden (pond, benches, trees, flowers), the building garden with its workbench, visitor parking, a bus stop and the road. Patient slots cover every case setting: outpatient, emergency, inpatient/ward, ICU, operating room and community.

greeting.zh-CN: 您好，欢迎来到临床方块综合医院。门诊在左手边，急诊分诊在右手边，检验科、病例讨论室和病房请沿中央走廊往里走。
greeting.en: Hello, welcome to ClinicalCraft General Hospital. Clinics are to your left, ED triage to your right; the lab, conference room and wards are down the central corridor.

greeting.zh-CN: 这里是急诊预检分诊。生命体征、体重和峰流速都可以在这儿测。
greeting.en: This is ED triage — vital signs, weight and peak flow can all be checked here.

greeting.zh-CN: 急诊护士站。需要上监护、建立静脉通路或采血就叫我，标本可以走气动物流直接送检验科。
greeting.en: ED nurse station. Call me for monitoring, IV access or bloods — samples go straight to the lab by pneumatic tube.

greeting.zh-CN: 救护车刚回站。院前交接在抢救室做，往里走右手边就是。
greeting.en: Ambulance just got back. We do the handover in the resus room — straight in and on your right.

greeting.zh-CN: 综合病房护士站。护理记录、医嘱执行和交班情况可以问我。
greeting.en: General ward nurse station. Ask me about nursing records, medication rounds or handover.

greeting.zh-CN: 影像科。X 线、CT、MRI、超声、PET-CT 和介入导管室都在后面这一排，申请单在这台控制台开。
greeting.en: Radiology. X-ray, CT, MRI, PET-CT, the cath lab and ultrasound are all along the back row — request scans at this console.

greeting.zh-CN: 检验科标本接收。血常规、生化、血气、尿液、微生物和配血都在这里做。
greeting.en: Laboratory specimen reception. Blood counts, chemistry, blood gases, urinalysis, microbiology and crossmatch are all done here.

greeting.zh-CN: 病理与遗传科。组织病理、细胞学、染色体核型和分子检测都可以在工作台申请。
greeting.en: Pathology & Genetics. Histopathology, cytology, karyotyping and molecular tests can be requested at the workstation.

greeting.zh-CN: 药房窗口。处方有疑问、需要核对剂量或配伍禁忌，都可以来问我。
greeting.en: Pharmacy window. Come to me with prescription queries, dose checks or drug interactions.

greeting.zh-CN: 来，把目前的证据摆到证据板上，我们一起梳理思路。
greeting.en: Come, put the evidence on the board and let's reason through it together.
